introCard.heading: All your recreational vehicle services under one roof
introCard.body: Clinique du VR brings repair, diagnostics, custom work and finishing into one workshop. We service RVs, travel trailers, boats and other recreational vehicles for mechanical work, maintenance, fiberglass, bodywork, paint, polishing, washing, brakes, axles, roof work, water intrusion and custom projects.

partsStore.heading: RV Parts and Accessories Store
partsStore.body: Visit us for a selection of parts and accessories for RV maintenance, repairs, and upgrades, including solar products. Our team can also help you identify the right product for your vehicle and check its availability.

seoSections.heading: Complete workshop in Gatineau
seoSections.body: Our workshop brings common and specialized work together: diagnostics, repair, maintenance, brakes, axles, roof work, water intrusion, layout changes, custom work and recreational vehicle preparation.

seoSections.heading: Fiberglass, bodywork and finishing
seoSections.body: We can work on fiberglass, gelcoat, cracks, impacts, panels, damaged corners and tired surfaces, with bodywork, paint, polishing and washing depending on the need.
